jims-engineering-management-technical-ca.description: JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus is a Greater Noida institute affiliated to Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, offering engineering, law, education and computer application programmes.
jims-engineering-management-technical-ca.about: The campus is in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida. It has been affiliated to Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, Delhi, for its B.Tech programme since 2013, and holds approvals from AICTE, BCI and NCTE. It offers engineering, law, BCA, journalism and education courses.
jims-engineering-management-technical-ca.address: 48/4, Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201308
jims-engineering-management-technical-ca.affiliated_to: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, New Delhi

jss-university-noida-uttar-pradesh.description: JSS University, Noida is a UGC-recognised private university in Sector 62, Noida, run under the JSS Mahavidyapeetha.
jss-university-noida-uttar-pradesh.about: The university was established in 2024 under the U.P. Private Universities Act No. 12 of 2019. Its campus is at C-20/1, Sector 62, Noida. It is recognised by UGC and holds AICTE approval.

kcc-institute-of-technology-and-manageme.description: KCC Institute of Technology and Management is an AKTU-affiliated engineering and management college in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida.
kcc-institute-of-technology-and-manageme.about: KCCITM was established in 2008 as an educational venture of KCC Software Limited. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. Its campus of about 40 acres is in Knowledge Park III.
kcc-institute-of-technology-and-manageme.address: 2B-2C, Knowledge Park-III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310
kcc-institute-of-technology-and-manageme.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

lloyd-institute-of-engineering-and-techn.description: Lloyd Institute of Engineering and Technology is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college of the Lloyd Group in Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida.
lloyd-institute-of-engineering-and-techn.about: LIET was formerly known as Skyline Institute of Engineering and Technology. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. It belongs to the Lloyd Group, which also runs management, law and pharmacy schools.
lloyd-institute-of-engineering-and-techn.address: Plot No. 3, Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201306
lloyd-institute-of-engineering-and-techn.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

lloyd-institute-of-management-and-techno.description: Lloyd Institute of Management and Technology is the management institute of the Lloyd Group in Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida.
lloyd-institute-of-management-and-techno.about: The institute is part of the Lloyd Group of Institutions, which runs schools of management, law, engineering and pharmacy. It is located in Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida.

maharishi-university-of-information-tech.description: This is the Noida campus of Maharishi University of Information Technology, a private university headquartered in Lucknow, located in Sector 110, Noida.
maharishi-university-of-information-tech.about: MUIT was established under UP Act No. 31 of 2001. It has campuses in Lucknow and Noida. The Noida campus offers B.Tech in computer science, with specialisations in AI, data science and cybersecurity, along with other programmes.
maharishi-university-of-information-tech.address: Sector 110, Noida, PO Maharishi Nagar, Gautam Budh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201304

mangalmay-institute-of-management-and-te.description: Mangalmay Institute of Management and Technology is a NAAC A-graded, AKTU-affiliated management and engineering institute in Knowledge Park, Greater Noida.
mangalmay-institute-of-management-and-te.about: The Mangalmay Group of Institutions was established in 2002. Its institute is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. It holds a NAAC A grade and offers MBA, B.Tech, BBA and BCA programmes.
mangalmay-institute-of-management-and-te.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

mgm-s-college-of-engineering-and-technol.description: MGM's College of Engineering and Technology is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college of the Mahatma Gandhi Mission trust in Sector 62, Noida.
mgm-s-college-of-engineering-and-technol.about: The college was started in 1999 by the Mahatma Gandhi Mission Educational Trust. It is located at Plot A-9, Sector 62, Noida. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and offers B.Tech programmes including computer science and mechanical engineering.
mgm-s-college-of-engineering-and-technol.address: Plot No. A-9, Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301
mgm-s-college-of-engineering-and-technol.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

noida-institute-of-engineering-and-techn.description: Noida Institute of Engineering and Technology is an autonomous private engineering college in Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida, with a NAAC A grade.
noida-institute-of-engineering-and-techn.about: NIET was established in 2001 and occupies a 13.9 acre campus in Knowledge Park II. UGC granted it autonomous status in 2020. It holds a NAAC A grade with a CGPA of 3.23.
noida-institute-of-engineering-and-techn.address: 19, Knowledge Park-II, Institutional Area, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201306

ram-eesh-institute-of-engineering-and-te.description: Ram-Eesh Institute of Engineering and Technology is part of the Ram-Eesh Group of Institutions in Knowledge Park I, Greater Noida.
ram-eesh-institute-of-engineering-and-te.about: The institute was established in 1999 under the Ram-Eesh Charitable Trust. It is located on Kasna Road in Knowledge Park I. It holds AICTE approval and AKTU affiliation.
ram-eesh-institute-of-engineering-and-te.address: Plot No. 3, Knowledge Park-1, Kasna Road, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310
ram-eesh-institute-of-engineering-and-te.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow
